content:
The HWPX output failed to include the expected month duration suffix for Phase 3 due to a date format mismatch.
The test failed with 'AssertionError' because the string '파일럿 운영 및 안정화 (2027-01) (1개월)' was missing from the XML content. The current regex logic failed to parse the shorthand date format '(2027-01)' and consequently did not append the required '(1개월)' duration suffix. The planner must update the date parsing logic to handle single-month formats and ensure the suffix is correctly appended to the target paragraph.
